examples: The soil is moist after the rain.
The cake is moist and soft.
Keep the seeds in moist soil until they sprout.
The dog's nose was cool and moist.
Moist air from the ocean brought fog.
There is snow on top of the mountain.
A goat lives on the mountain.

more.def: A very high area of land, much taller than a hill.
examples: It took the climbers three days to reach the top of the mountain.
The mountain was hidden in clouds.
A cold stream runs down the side of the mountain.
